retain_rule: Keep every first-draw family that passes the declared boundary. Dev first, then train; never move a first-draw train family to dev or vice versa.
supplement_rule: MuSiQue: continue the same seed20261017 maximum-step question selection and family ordering, descending native max steps. TwoWiki: unused families by descending native support-title count then family ID; choose a maximum-support question using seed20261017+numeric family ID. Never reroll after annotations or model outcomes.
boundary: All selected family members remain assigned to one role. Actual selected pools compared privately in both target-to-pool directions by exact title/text and title, plus exact questions. Dev and train both exclude new reserved whole-family pools and old reserved cases. Train also excludes all final dev pools and prior registered dev/calibration/test source pools. Cross-dataset shared target titles merge source families for counting; do not count two copies as independent.
coverage: Native hop/support counts are only selection strata. Independent semantic relations, depth, minimal paragraph proofs, ambiguity and alternatives are established by full source-first review; no hard label from metadata.
review_rule: Export admitted train/dev visible pools without answers/support flags/decompositions. Save all source annotations before native-reference comparison. New reserved text remains unexposed to the reviewer until method freeze.
